title: Failure to comply with terms and conditions of an order of the court.
bodyText: If a party fails to comply with the terms and conditions of an order issued by the court under this chapter, the court may apply the provisions of section 710-1077 and any other provisions available under the law.
bodyHtml:
PART V.  MISCELLANEOUS

 

     [§587A-37]  Failure to comply with terms and conditions of an order of the court.  If a party fails to comply with the terms and conditions of an order issued by the court under this chapter, the court may apply the provisions of section 710-1077 and any other provisions available under the law. [L 2010, c 135, pt of §1]
